question: I want to cast Repulsor Blast, which has teamwork 2, so that it also deals 2 damage to the creature's controller. The only untapped creatures I control are two 1/1s. Can I tap both of them together to pay the teamwork cost, even though neither has power 2 on its own?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: teamwork N lets you tap any number of creatures you control with total power N or more as an additional cost, so two 1/1s together pay teamwork 2.
expected.answer: 702.194a Teamwork represents a static ability that functions while the spell with teamwork is on the stack. “Teamwork N” means “As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap any number of creatures you control with total power N or more.” Paying a spell’s teamwork cost follows the rules for paying additional costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h.

whyHard: Players read "teamwork 2" as needing a single creature with power 2 or more, or as tapping exactly one creature, but the cost counts the total power of any number of tapped creatures.
